checkedAlternates.risk: MP4 containers can also hold audio-only tracks.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The rule uses the ordinary primary use of the named file format; an MP4 movie is the intended reading.

checkedAlternates.risk: GIF can contain animation and look like a short video.
checkedAlternates.resolution: GIF has an image media type, even when it contains multiple frames.
